items.title: Compact centered photo presentation
items.precondition: Signed in with a conversation that contains one portrait image and one landscape image.
steps: Open each image from its message bubble at desktop width.
Confirm the visible 'Image preview' label, header separator, opaque dialog panel, and broad inner padding are absent.
Resize to a narrow/mobile viewport and open both images again.
items.expected: Each image appears as a centered floating object, never exceeds 70vh height or 24rem width, fits within the viewport, and has no broad white frame around it.
items.evidence: User-validated locally on 2026-08-19 after the compact 24rem viewer was restored without click-to-zoom.
items.notes: The compact X continues to use difference blending to maintain contrast without a visible background.

items.title: Accessible dismissal behavior
items.precondition: A received image is available in a signed-in conversation.
steps: Open the image and confirm keyboard focus lands on the visible overlay Close action.
Close once with the overlay control, once by clicking the shaded backdrop, and once with Escape.
For each close path, confirm the viewer closes and the page scrolls normally afterward.
Inspect the open dialog with accessibility tooling or its rendered attributes.
items.expected: All dismissal paths work, closing restores page scrolling, and the dialog has an accessible name even though no visible title is rendered.
items.notes: The existing backdrop, Escape listener, focus ref, and scroll cleanup remain intact; the dialog has aria-label='Chat image'.

items.title: Image-message row spacing
items.precondition: A conversation contains consecutive image messages and at least one consecutive text-message pair.
steps: View two consecutive image messages from the same sender.
View an image followed immediately by a text message from the same sender.
View two consecutive text messages from the same sender.
items.expected: Image thumbnails and the following text do not overlap; the existing compact text-only grouping remains intact.
items.notes: Image-bearing message rows now break compact grouping, while text-only groups retain their existing compact spacing.

items.title: Dark-mode photo backdrop
items.precondition: A received image is available; test both global dark mode and Messages-specific dark mode when available.
steps: Open a received photo in global dark mode.
Open a received photo in Messages-specific dark mode.
Open the same viewer in light mode, then open another modal in dark mode.
items.expected: The photo viewer’s backdrop is black and blurred in either dark mode. Light mode retains the existing lighter backdrop, and unrelated modal backdrops are unchanged.
items.notes: The selector covers both global .dark and Messages-specific .messages-theme-dark roots.

items.title: Frontend verification gate
items.expected: All commands exit successfully with no errors caused by this change.
items.evidence: 2026-08-19: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck, npm --prefix frontend run lint, and npm --prefix frontend run build completed successfully after removing click-to-zoom, correcting image-row spacing, and adding the dark-mode photo backdrop.
items.notes: Lint emitted six pre-existing warnings outside the changed files. Vite emitted its existing large-chunk advisory.
